schema:name: Geographic Locality: Indigenous place-name pointers (prototype)
schema:description: DiSSCo MAS Hackathon 2026 prototype (Geographic Place Names team). Comments on a specimen location with links to entries in the Norwegian place-name register (Kartverket SSR) that hold Indigenous (Sámi) names. Copies no names. Built without Sámi input; not reviewed by Sámi representatives.
